userGuide.rationale: Every user-visible 0.23.1 change was documented in docs/user in the commit that made it: the Linux in-app update fix and the one manual .deb update from 0.23.0 (getting-started), Linux recording through Ubuntu's FFmpeg with recordingEncoderUnavailable and the doctor check (cli.md, command-line.md), update details during an active download and Import Complete labels (system-settings), and the PLVS Default preset name. The feedback dialog change only moves the existing Attach Diagnostics description into a help tip; system-settings already describes its content.

readme.rationale: README highlights make no claim affected by this release. The Ubuntu download row's 'APT package with verified in-app updates' was already the promise; 0.23.1 makes it work rather than changing it, and the manual step for 0.23.0 users belongs in the user guide and release notes.

website.rationale: No homepage, Sharesets or privacy text changes. Platform cards name packages only. Privacy: Linux recording encodes locally with the distribution FFmpeg, the Linux updater still installs the already-downloaded signed package offline, and feedback diagnostics content is unchanged, so no collection, transmission, recipient or retention change.
